# model.bitmap

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the model bitmap.

```lua
local bitmap = model.bitmap([bitmap])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bitmap` | string | optional |  |

## Returns

bitmap (string)

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 6 times across 4 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    if model and model.bitmap then
        local bm = model.bitmap()
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/widgets/dashboard/objects/image/model.lua:137](https://github.com/rotorflight/rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite/blob/53c7e819afe6293cb7623b5972e4a4d276a90ad1/src/rfsuite/widgets/dashboard/objects/image/model.lua#L137-L138)</small>

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    local function getModelBitmapName()
        if not (model and model.bitmap) then return nil end
        local bm = model.bitmap()
        if bm and type(bm) == "string" and bm ~= "" and not string.find(bm, "default_") then
            return bm
        end
        return nil
    end
    ```
